bg.$description: Fill of the skip link while it is shown: brand pink (BR-01), the fill of a primary button, so it reads as an action.

fg.$description: Text color of the skip link: black on the pink fill, 8.37:1 (BR-01, derived facts in SPEC.md §2.1).

color.$description: Outline color of the skip link: the same pink as the fill, as on a primary button (BR-10).

width.$description: Outline width of the skip link (BR-10, BR-13): the thick stroke of an interactive element.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the skip link: the chunky radius of an interactive element (ADR-0050).

z.$description: Stacking level of the shown skip link: the highest level, so it sits above the sticky site header and above an open overlay (ADR-0072).

color.$description: Focus ring color of the skip link (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

width.$description: Focus ring width of the skip link (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between the skip link and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of the skip link (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).
